rationale: Adds HostRunLoop and register_host_run_loop to the platform layer and a non-Apple MainThreadScope and MainThreadTimer that run through it, for plug-in editors inside a Linux host. The Apple implementation is unchanged apart from registration stubs. This is a Pulp-only edit: Vellum's framework transfer is in effect and Vellum's own editors do not use the platform main-thread layer off Apple.
